 ▐▛███▜▌   Claude Code v2.1.17
▝▜█████▛▘  Sonnet 4.5 · API Usage Billing
  ▘▘ ▝▝    ~/src/ws/oss/csm-astrocyte

Bash command
cat << 'EOF' > /etc/systemd/system/astrocyte.service
[Unit]
Description=Astrocyte Daemon - Claude Code Session Manager Watchdog
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -u /home/user/src/ws/oss/csm-astrocyte/astrocyte.py
Restart=always
RestartSec=10
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal
SyslogIdentifier=astrocyte
User=user
Environment="PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1"

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
